description: This Java class 'LwM2mServerListener' implements various server event listeners for LwM2M protocol interactions, including registration, presence, observation, and send events, delegating handling to an associated service.

classes.name: LwM2mServerListener
classes.description: A listener class handling registration, presence, observation, and send events for LwM2M server, delegating actions to a service handler.

methods.name: LwM2mServerListener
methods.description: Constructor initializing the listener with a service handler.

methods.name: registrationListener
methods.description: Handles registration events: registration, update, and unregistration.

methods.name: presenceListener
methods.description: Handles presence events: sleeping and awake states.

methods.name: observationListener
methods.description: Handles observation events: cancellation, response, error, and new observations.

methods.name: sendListener
methods.description: Handles send request events: data reception and errors.
